candidate_evidence.quote: Determine the efficacy, as measured by the 4-month progression free survival (PFS) rate, of propranolol and imipramine, when used in combination with bevacizumab for the treatment of recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Master protocol testing a digital monitoring platform with SOC systemic therapy, plus Subprotocol 1 (PRIME) randomising recurrent GBM patients on bevacizumab to propranolol or imipramine. Each is the sole investigational agent in its own group, coded experimental_monotherapy; the primary objective wording ('propranolol and imipramine ... in combination with bevacizumab') could also be read as a combination. Registry lists both propranolol and imipramine under the Group A arm and bevacizumab only under Group B, which conflicts with the arm text; arms follow the arm descriptions. Bevacizumab is SOC in both groups.
